source_snapshot.purpose_facts: Evaluate GPGPU performance by training Minigo.
procedure_facts: No repository revision, dataset, board size, self-play/training/evaluation pipeline, command or metric is supplied.
criteria_facts: Greater than an unspecified official NVIDIA MLPerf score.
source_conflicts: The testcase defines Minigo training but cites an undefined official MLPerf NVIDIA score; no MLPerf Minigo benchmark/profile is identified.
missing_source_information: Framework/backend, data/checkpoint, precision, GPU count, iterations/duration and reproducibility seed.
Training metric and valid comparable baseline.

original_test_intent.statement: Evaluate the designated GPGPU platform with an engineer-approved Minigo training workload for the intended 90-minute machine window and compare reproducible training performance and health with a valid Minigo-specific baseline.
must_preserve: Minigo training, not inference or GPU inventory.
A real training workload and 60/90-minute planning intent.
must_not_infer: That Minigo here is an official MLPerf benchmark.
NVIDIA/CUDA on an unknown GPU backend.
A repository, board size, training stage, metric or reference from another testcase.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 correctly notes that inventory is not training, rejects NVIDIA-only assumptions and requires Minigo repo/data/framework/config plus a valid baseline.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2 does not force a choice among self-play generation, model training and evaluation, nor require seed/checkpoint/board-size identity and a throughput-versus-quality completion rule for a 90-minute run.

related_records: MLPerf inference cases cannot define this non-MLPerf Minigo training workload.
applicable_history.precedence_application: The invalid MLPerf criterion cannot be used; a Minigo-specific baseline and pipeline must be supplied without changing the training intent.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Keep Minigo training automatable after handoff, but block workload execution until the pipeline stage, 90-minute profile, exact artifacts and non-MLPerf acceptance baseline replace the invalid score criterion.

conditions_present: Minigo training and GPGPU performance intent are clear.
missing: Implementation, pipeline stage, backend/artifacts, duration/iterations, metric, baseline, resource limits and recovery.
provider: GPU/lab owner approves sustained load and baseline.
safe_read_only_work: Inventory GPU/CPU/topology/driver/framework and capacity; inspect proposed repository/artifact metadata without training.
prohibited_until_resolved: Install, generate self-play data, train/evaluate, tune clocks, clear logs or PASS.
closure_evidence: Minigo-specific performance/quality baseline and health limits.

revision_candidate.test_name: Run the Approved Minigo GPU Training Workload
revision_candidate.purpose: Execute the signed Minigo training pipeline on the designated GPU SUT for the approved 90-minute workload, measure reproducible training throughput and quality progression, and compare results with a Minigo-specific baseline while preserving platform-health evidence.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Exact GPU vendor/model/count/topology, CPU/NUMA/memory/storage, driver/runtime/framework, Minigo repository commit, board/game configuration, data/checkpoint and container/environment. CUDA and ROCm are not interchangeable.
revision_candidate.target_scope: The explicitly selected Minigo stage: self-play generation, training and any required evaluation must be named separately. Preserve Machine Time 90 and Attended Time 60 as planning intent; exact active-training window, steps/games and repetitions must be signed.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Repository/commit/license; framework/backend/container hashes; GPU allocation; board/model/hyperparameters/precision/batch size; self-play data and checkpoint provenance; seed; stage sequence; 90-minute mapping or step/game counts; throughput, loss/quality and baseline criteria; telemetry/abort limits; output retention and recovery.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Verify hashes/config and baseline health, stage only approved data/checkpoints, then execute the signed Minigo stage sequence with full commands/logs and fixed seed/profile. Record active training time, games/positions/steps per second, loss/quality trajectory and resource telemetry. Do not substitute an inventory command or label the result MLPerf.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Pipeline and baseline signed; artifacts licensed/pinned; sufficient storage/memory/cooling/power; no competing GPU load; checkpoint/output/recovery paths approved.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: System/GPU topology; code/container/framework/data/checkpoint/config hashes; exact commands, seed and stage boundaries; active duration and completed games/positions/steps; throughput and loss/quality/evaluation trajectory; GPU utilization/memory/power/thermal/clocks; XID/ECC/kernel/SEL logs; output/checkpoint manifest; baseline comparison; final health.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Signed Minigo-specific baseline for the same implementation, stage, hardware allocation, board/model, data/checkpoint, precision and duration/steps. Pass requires the performance and quality-progression rules plus clean health; an MLPerf score or `nvidia-smi` output is invalid.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not invent pipeline stages, overwrite checkpoints/data, use unlicensed data, assume NVIDIA, change clocks/power/hyperparameters without approval, expand beyond the signed GPU set, clear logs or claim MLPerf status.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: ML owner signs pipeline/quality/baseline; data/software owner approves artifacts; platform owner approves load/resources; human judges result and checkpoint retention.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Humans define the missing scientific workload and baseline. The Agent executes the frozen pipeline and collects evidence only after gates.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On divergence, NaN, data/checkpoint corruption or platform limit, stop cleanly, preserve logs and last approved checkpoint, restore tuning/services, verify health and require approval before resumption.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Pipeline/stage/duration/baseline remains undefined; artifact/license mismatch; wrong backend/GPU allocation; NaN/divergence, corrupt data/checkpoint, storage exhaustion, XID/ECC/thermal/power/host limit, monitoring/evidence loss.

identified_defects: Minigo is incorrectly tied to an undefined MLPerf NVIDIA score.
Training stage and executable profile are absent.
No reproducibility, quality or 90-minute completion rule.
reason_for_change: Convert an inventory-only handoff into a real Minigo training contract without inventing a pipeline or mislabeling it MLPerf.

new_technical_evidence.title: Source testcase Wistron-Performance GPU-00053-V003
new_technical_evidence.supports: Minigo training intent, 60/90-minute metadata and conflicting MLPerf criterion.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: Every executable workload and baseline parameter is missing.

new_technical_evidence.title: MLPerf Training reference benchmarks
new_technical_evidence.supports: An official comparison must identify a defined benchmark/release; this testcase identifies no MLPerf Minigo profile.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The intended Minigo implementation is unknown.

removed_ambiguities: Requires stage-specific throughput plus quality progression and reproducibility.
resolved_blockers: Repo/data/config are provider-closable and do not imply permanent BLOCKED.
remaining_blockers: Invalid acceptance criterion and missing pipeline/profile require ML engineer decision.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 defines the precise missing Minigo stage, reproducibility, quality, checkpoint and recovery boundaries while preserving the real training intent and 90-minute plan.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Contract-only validation was CLEAR. The validator preserved the signed Minigo stages and 90-minute intent; rejected inventory-only completion, invented pipeline stages, NVIDIA/CUDA assumptions and MLPerf labeling; required reproducible throughput plus quality progression, checkpoint provenance, retention and health evidence; and kept scientific pipeline/baseline decisions with engineers. No document defect was found. This is not independent-model or DUT validation.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Performance row 37 says Minigo training for Machine Time 90 but supplies no training command and cites an undefined MLPerf NV score.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 rejects inventory-only review; V3 additionally freezes pipeline stages, reproducibility, quality and checkpoint recovery.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Inventory only is safe; no training/data/checkpoint mutation until pipeline and baseline are signed.
